description: ntex 4 on its native runtime. Routing and extractors through ntex::web, JSON through HttpResponse::json. Static files served from disk per request, choosing a pre-compressed .br/.gz sibling off Accept-Encoding. async-db with deadpool's unmanaged pool (sized from DATABASE_MAX_CONN). fortunes rendered through an Askama template. json-tls and static-tls over HTTP/1.1 with rustls on 8081; baseline-h2 and static-h2 over h2 on 8443.
